prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D mobile game BACKGROUND LAYER ONLY, portrait 9:16, tall 1080x1920 composition. A richly hand-painted warm Russian language classroom / wood library, polished cozy storybook realism with amber honey walnut textures, golden highlights and soft afternoon sun. Exact functional composition: shelves of burgundy, navy and dark green leather books across top 0%-12% and along far right edge; tall wood-mullioned window on far LEFT edge, with blue sky and distant colorful onion-dome architecture; window extends down left edge to 68% height. Center x=10%-90%, y=12%-84% is a quiet warm wooden backing wall, unobstructed, because separate opaque paper and blackboard panels will cover it. NO center board of any kind. At bottom 84%-100% a warmly lit wooden desktop: blank open cream exercise book centered near 94% height with a tiny gold architectural sketch but NO letters, fountain pen to its left, blue-white porcelain tea cup and steam near right at 92% height. Left lower edge has stacked dark leather books, a small painted wooden nesting doll, a globe and delicate white flowers in a blue-white ceramic vase, mostly confined to outer left 14% and below 78% height; these are decorative atmosphere. Leave lower right x=65%-100%, y=48%-85% simple warm low-contrast library background for a separate teacher portrait. High quality material detail, tactile wood, porcelain and paper, bright but warm cream and gold color scheme matching a premium educational adventure game. Camera eye-level, mainly frontal. NO people, no teacher, no blackboard, no parchment menu, no controls, no progress HUD, no text, no numbers, no lettering on books, no watermarks. This is an ORIGINAL environment painting to sit behind independent runtime UI, not a mockup screenshot.
prompts.parchment: Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated transparent production game UI FRAME, portrait width:height about 0.62:1, roughly 900x1450 tall. Create a richly hand-painted honey walnut carved wooden frame surrounding an entirely BLANK warm ivory parchment panel for a vertical mobile learning menu. Frontal flat view, no perspective. Complete outer frame visible with clean smooth real alpha silhouette and small transparent margin. Top center has a medium-small integrated cream-gold crest with a delicate dark brown onion-dome architectural silhouette and floral curls, keep crest within top 10% of total height, NOT oversized. Rounded shaped upper shoulders, gold bevel highlights, warm varnished wood grain, fine double gold inner rule, tactile cream parchment paper with very subtle grain and softly aged margins (not burnt). Small elegant rowan berry and olive leaf sprays at upper inner left and right corners, only in margins; restrained curling gold leaf carving at bottom corners. Main center x=10%-90%, y=13%-92% is completely EMPTY pale cream writing space, no internal panels. This is only a background frame layer. Absolutely NO text, no letters, no numbers, no titles, no cards, no buttons, no icons in central area, no teacher, no books or tea cups in center, no classroom scene, no checkerboard, no opaque white or black backdrop, no watermark. Premium warm illustrated Russian classroom UI material style, calm and readable center, delicate border thickness about 3% width.
prompts.blackboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated EMPTY vertical classroom BLACKBOARD game frame, real transparent outside silhouette. Portrait-ish board width:height about 0.88:1, around 950x1080. Completely frontal flat view. Rich honey walnut polished wooden frame, warm copper-gold beveled edges and ornate brass corner fittings, thin tidy inner chalk border around deep forest-green subtly chalk-textured surface. Upper corners gently rounded, bottom rail dark amber wood. No big crest above this board; top edge is a straight substantial wood beam. Tiny delicate cream chalk drawing of a closed book and quill at bottom LEFT, restrained chalk vine curl at bottom center, a small decorative onion-dome skyline in the UPPER RIGHT corner below the frame, confined to outermost 16% width and 20% height. Main writing center x=12%-84%, y=6%-89% completely BLANK calm dark green, no words or internal frames. Professional soft storybook realism, tactile wood grain, fine low-contrast erased chalk texture. Preserve large clean negative space for dynamically rendered title, word and FOUR vertical answer buttons. Clean RGBA outside frame, complete board visible with small transparent margins. Absolutely NO text, no numerals, no title ribbon, no buttons, no answer choices, no teacher, no people, no classroom background, no fake checkerboard. A standalone empty environment prop only, NOT a rendered game screen.
prompts.modeIconsAtlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SINGLE production sprite atlas with exactly THREE related school menu icons in one horizontal row on a true transparent canvas. Canvas wide 3:1, ideally 1536x512. Divide mentally into three EQUAL square cells, icon centered in each cell, clear separation and transparent padding of 12% per cell; no grid lines. LEFT cell: open ivory notebook with red ruled lines and a golden fountain pen diagonally across its right page. CENTER cell: two overlapping warm parchment flashcards with one dark brown circular two-arrow refresh symbol on the front card. RIGHT cell: a thick closed burgundy leather dictionary with rich gold border, tiny gold ornamental symbol in center, cream page edges and red ribbon bookmark. NO letters or words on any icon, no numbers. All three use matching polished soft storybook painterly game UI style, golden amber edge light, warm hand-painted paper and leather texture, clear large silhouettes and restrained tiny shadows. Frontal/slightly tilted flat illustration, no heavy 3D perspective. Each icon must stay entirely within its own equal cell. No text labels, no button backgrounds, no UI panel, no people, no classroom environment, no white/black opaque background, no checkerboard. This one atlas will be split by engine regions into three independent dynamic clickable mode cards.
